Net turnover decreased 29.6% to EUR 11.1 million from EUR 15.8 million, mainly because of lower sales volumes and a high comparison base in 2025, when revenue had benefited from an adjustment recognized under contractual terms.
Gross profit declined 66.5% to EUR 1.2 million from EUR 3.5 million.
Net finance income decreased to EUR 0.2 million from EUR 0.3 million, while the company reported a net loss of EUR 1.4 million compared with a profit of EUR 0.9 million previously.

verified_key_information_units.information: Performance decline was primarily driven by three external factors: loss of control over Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian confiscation of the Talvis distillery; and a global spirits market downturn, compounded by delayed excise tax payments that led to bank account freezes.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: In January 2026, a trustee was appointed for Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian authorities designated related entities as 'extremist' and confiscated the Group-owned Talvis distillery; global spirits market downturn; delayed excise tax payments caused SRS to freeze bank accounts.

candidate_sentences.text: The results were affected by several external and group-related developments.

In January 2026, a trustee was appointed for related company Stoli Group (USA), LLC following Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, causing the group to lose control of its U.S. operations and directly affecting the solvency of the company’s largest customer.
The group also reported aggressive actions by Russian authorities, including the designation of related entities as extremist and the confiscation of the group-owned Talvis distillery.
In addition, the global spirits market experienced a downturn, with declining volumes, weaker discretionary spending and inventory adjustments in distribution channels.
These pressures created substantial cash-flow difficulties and delayed excise-tax payments.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company initiated Legal Protection Proceedings (LPP) in January 2026 (court-approved in February) to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations; the deadline for the LPP action plan was later extended to October 2026, with legal effects remaining in force until August 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Filed LPP application on 30 January 2026, approved on 5 February 2026; court set initial plan deadline of 5 June 2026, later extended to 5 October 2026; legal consequences remain until 5 August 2026.

candidate_sentences.text: After the State Revenue Service froze the company’s bank accounts, Amber Latvijas balzams applied for legal protection proceedings on 30 January 2026; the Riga City Court approved the application on 5 February.
The proceedings are intended to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations.

verified_key_information_units.information: The LPP filing automatically triggered an event of default under the Principal Shareholder's (Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l.) bond documentation, which in turn triggered events of default under its bank financing arrangements.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: The filing of the LPP application also automatically triggered an event of default for Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l. under the terms of its issued bond documentation. This, in turn, automatically triggered events of default by the Principal Shareholder under its financing arrangements with banks.

verified_key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the report period, in April 2026 the Principal Shareholder initiated judicial reorganization proceedings (réorganisation judiciaire) in Luxembourg, receiving a four-month moratorium until August 2026, during which enforcement actions against bondholders are suspended.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Pursuant to the judgment of the Luxembourg District Court sitting in commercial matters dated 24 April 2026, Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l. has been authorized to initiate judicial reorganization proceedings; the Court has granted the Principal Shareholder a four-month moratorium until 24 August 2026, which suspends enforcement actions and collateral enforcement.

candidate_sentences.text: Subsequent to the period, the principal shareholder entered Luxembourg judicial reorganization proceedings with a moratorium until 24 August 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational efficiency indicators showed mixed results: the Right First Time (RFT) rate improved to 99.5% (Q1 2025: 98.4%), but the On Time In Full (OTIF) rate declined sharply to 70.3% (Q1 2025: 97.5%).

Management is conducting an additional assessment of doubtful receivables provisions established in prior periods and strengthening the finance function as part of governance enhancements to ensure financial stability.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, and K8 are all PRESENT with clear coverage in the candidate summary. K5 is MISSING because there is no mention of the automatic default triggered under the Principal Shareholder's bond documentation or subsequent defaults under bank financing. K7 is MISSING because there is no reference to operational efficiency indicators like RFT or OTIF rates. The overall coverage is strong for most HIGH criteria, but the absence of K5 and K7 (one HIGH, one MEDIUM) prevents a full 'Yes' score, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It presents a consistent narrative of declining financial performance, clearly links causes (volume decline, external pressures, operational issues) to effects (profit/loss changes, cash flow difficulties), and maintains logical flow from performance deterioration to specific financial metrics and eventual legal proceedings. No self-contradictions are present, explanations follow logically from preceding statements, organization is clear and progressive, and there is no material repetition that reduces clarity. The summary forms a coherent whole describing a deteriorating business situation with identified challenges and responses.
